eva_support: Escalation from AcmeCorp. After yesterday's model swap to redwood/llama3-v2-quant their downstream parser started failing. They call our API -> our hosted webhook -> their consumer which expects a top-level object, but the model responses are coming back as an array in some cases and with trailing commas in streaming chunks. Repro quick info below.

eva_support: Customer error: `JSONDecodeError: Expecting property name enclosed in double quotes: line 1 column 2 (char 1)` when calling `json.loads(body)` on our webhook payload. Their schema expects `{"items": [...]}` but they get `[...]`.

eva_support: Sample request (simplified):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood/llama3-v2-quant","mode":"structured","prompt":"List items as JSON with key items"}'
```

eva_support: Sample response body received by customer (streamed chunks concatenated):
```json
[
  {"id":"a1","name":"foo"},
  {"id":"b2","name":"bar"},
]
```

eva_support: Note the trailing comma after the last element and top-level array instead of the expected object. Customer reports failure started right after we pushed the canary swap `v2.10.1` for the llama3 family.

kevin_prod: Thanks. Can you paste the request_id(s) and the exact model name we routed to? Also which route (hosted/dedicated/private)?

eva_support: Asked for request ids, sent two: `req_20260215_9a1` and `req_20260215_bf4`. Both routed through hosted API (region: us-west-2). Model tag: `redwood/llama3-v2-quant@sha256:7f3b...`.

deploy-bot: canary-swap complete: deployment `canary/redwood-llama3-v2` -> tag `v2.10.1` at 2026-02-28T03:12:10Z by `ci/cd`.

mike_ml: Quick hypothesis: the structured-output postprocessor was refactored last week to coalesce token-level frames into a single JSON blob for performance. It looks like the coalescer sometimes emits an outer array when multiple top-level fragments are present, and we recently turned on an aggressive chunk-merge setting for quantized paths. That would produce an array wrapper and could leave trailing commas if chunk boundaries are concatenated naively.

mike_ml: Also possible: a patch to streaming framing changed last-chunk handling (we dropped a strip of trailing separators).

lisa_engineer: Repro steps I ran locally against the canary: pinned to `redwood/llama3-v2-quant@v2.10.1`, invoked structured mode with a prompt that yields multiple items. I saw the same array wrapper in the assembled stream. Example captured in logs: `assembled_payload = "[... ,]"`.

lisa_engineer: Temporary mitigation: set header `X-Structured-Version: v1` or pin model to `redwood/llama3-v2-quant@v2.9.8` — that avoids the new coalescer. We'll push a hotfix to ensure coalescer removes trailing separators and preserves top-level object shape when a single object is expected.

kevin_prod: Can we do a soft rollback for affected tenant(s) tonight? Also want an ETA for a fix and a patch release.

mike_ml: We should be able to flip the coalescer flag in runtime config quickly (hot config) and redeploy a safe canary. I'll prepare a patch to sanitize trailing separators and detect expected shape (object vs array) from the prompt metadata.

eva_support: Customer needs a mitigation now — they've paused ingestion and will be blocked for the next 12h if we don't provide a fix. They asked for either a rollback or a signed timeline.

lisa_engineer: I'll coordinate rollback. Plan: 1) Hot flip coalescer off for hosted canary groups handling structured mode (5m). 2) Redeploy sanitized serializer build with tests (1-2h). 3) Gradual promote after validation.

kevin_prod: Please include a clear inbound/outbound audit log snippet we can send to the customer (showing request ids + before/after).

lisa_engineer: Will attach logs. For now, workaround for customers: add a webhook preprocessor to accept both array/object and trim trailing commas (example regex `,\s*]$ -> ]`). We'll also offer to pin them back to `v2.9.8`.

eva_support: I've informed AcmeCorp of the mitigation and offered rollback or webhook preprocessor. They're leaning rollback.

kevin_prod: Open internal incident INC-2026-014 for tracking and send to oncall. I'll update SLA impact and billing risk if any.

deploy-bot: incident INC-2026-014 created by kevin_prod at 2026-02-28T04:05:02Z.

mike_ml: I'll follow up with a root-cause PR and unit tests for streaming assembly to prevent trailing separators and ensure expected top-level shape is preserved.

lisa_engineer: Rolling the hot flip now for the affected canary group. Will report back in ~10m. :hourglass:
